title: EDX document, version 1.0
description: An Electronics Design eXchange document. Every section is optional. Specification: https://github.com/digimap2000/edx-format/blob/main/spec/edx.md

edx.description: EDX version, MAJOR.MINOR. This schema reads 1.x.

extras.description: Application-specific data. Readers preserve it and never give it meaning (section 12.4).

extensions.description: Extension data on this object, keyed by extension name (section 12.3).

name.description: A name: non-empty, no leading or trailing white space (section 2.6).

positive_length.description: A length in millimetres, greater than zero.

non_negative_length.description: A length in millimetres, zero or more.

angle.description: An angle in degrees, counter-clockwise as seen from the top.

point.description: A point [x, y] in millimetres; x right, y down (section 2.2).

shape.description: An area as SVG path data in the EDX subset: absolute M, L, H, V, A and Z only; every subpath closed; the first subpath is the outer boundary, the rest are holes (section 2.5).

shapes.description: One or more shapes, covering their union.

pad_ref.description: A pad on the board. Display form part.pad, never parsed (section 2.6).

inputs.description: Hashes of the sections a result was made from (section 11).

zone_connection.description: How copper fill connects to a pad.

layer.description: A copper layer. The stack-up runs top first; the first is named top and the last bottom.

plane_net.description: For a plane layer, the net that fills it.

outline.description: The board's shape; holes are cut-outs.

stackup.description: Copper layers in order, top first.

drill.description: A round hole or a slot.

number.description: Pad number. Pads sharing a number are one electrical pad.

outline.description: For a polygon pad: one shape, relative to the pad's position, before rotation.

package.description: Footprint geometry, as seen from the top (section 5.2).

courtyard.description: Courtyard on the package's own side; the other side optional.

placement.description: free: no position until an engine gives one. fixed: the position is mandated (section 5.3).

package.description: The id of a package in the document.

class.description: A net class in rules; default when absent.

region.description: A named area that excludes things (section 5.5).

priority.description: Higher wins; a plane's own net is 0.

relation.description: Design intent between two pads, with no values (section 6).

id.description: Optional; if stated it must equal kind:subject:object (section 6.1).

source.description: Where the relation came from: free text or a URI.

layer_override.description: Values for one layer, overriding the class.

net_class.description: Electrical rules for a net class. Classes other than default take omitted values from default (section 8.2).

relation_rules.description: Values for each relation kind (section 8.3). Unknown keys are errors.

rules.description: Board minimums, net classes and relation rules (section 8).

constraint_extension.description: A constraint type defined by an extension.

placed_part.description: A part's placement. A placed part has at, angle and side; an unplaced part has none of them.

report.description: The status of every constraint, and the gates (section 11.2).
